title: KIZMI 2026 – Kizomba Milano International Festival
description:
📅📅 17/18/19/20 December 2026 📅📅
Location: Milano – Italy (KLIMA Hotel, Via Privata Venezia Giulia, 8, 20157 Milano MI)

▶️ Link FB Page: https://www.facebook.com/KizombaMilanoFestival/
